fact: The Nkafu brief says Cameroon's legal framework is anchored in a 2010 cybersecurity law and 2012 decrees, and calls for the 2010 law to be revised; it dates the statement to the brief's publication on 2026-09-04.
Le Jour reports a workshop on 8-9 June 2026 in Yaounde that reviewed articles of law no. 2010/012 of 21 December 2010 on cybercrime in Cameroon, which is treated as the existing law.
